note: Every item is unverified: nothing here was checked against the hardware. basis says where an item came from: live-script (a constant read from Live's installed MiniLab_3 script), midi-standard (the usual meaning of that message, assumed), arturia-default (assumed), unknown (no message known: learn it). The profile is for Anthony's session at the MiniLab.

ports.source: the port name macOS gives a MiniLab 3, not read from a machine here; set ZPKT_MINILAB_PORT to override
